name: Irina Volkovskaya
bio:
Irina's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during her university years, while studying engineering in Moscow. A chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that quickly consumed her. She started as a volunteer, assisting with data analysis and quickly demonstrated a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics and driver performance. Her organizational skills and analytical mind led her to become a test driver coordinator.

At Allied Racing, Irina thrives on optimizing testing schedules and ensuring seamless communication between drivers, engineers, and mechanics. She's known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to extract valuable insights from testing data. Irina is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance and contribute to the team's success. Her ambition fuels her commitment to finding innovative testing strategies, always seeking to uncover that extra edge that could make the difference on race day. Her colleagues admire her dedication and work ethic.

What sets Irina apart is her ability to blend technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills. She understands the pressures faced by test drivers and works tirelessly to create a supportive and productive testing environment. She believes clear communication and mutual respect are crucial for achieving optimal results. She is eager to build her career and rise to a leadership role within a top-tier racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair typically worn in a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Irina is of average height with a slender build, and is generally seen wearing practical attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of clicking her pen when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every test session with a specific good luck ritual.
